Usage: prime eval run [-h] [--env-args ENV_ARGS] [--env-dir-path ENV_DIR_PATH]
               [--provider {prime,openrouter,openai,anthropic,minimax,deepseek,glm,local,vllm}]
               [--endpoints-path ENDPOINTS_PATH] [--model MODEL]
               [--api-client-type {openai_completions,openai_chat_completions,openai_chat_completions_token,openai_responses,renderer,anthropic_messages,nemorl_chat_completions}]
               [--api-key-var API_KEY_VAR] [--api-base-url API_BASE_URL]
               [--header HEADER] [--header-from-state HEADER_FROM_STATE]
               [--num-examples NUM_EXAMPLES]
               [--rollouts-per-example ROLLOUTS_PER_EXAMPLE] [--shuffle]
               [--shuffle-seed SHUFFLE_SEED] [--max-concurrent MAX_CONCURRENT]
               [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temperature TEMPERATURE]
               [--sampling-args SAMPLING_ARGS] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
               [--verbose] [--no-interleave-scoring]
               [--state-columns STATE_COLUMNS] [--save-results]
               [--resume [PATH]] [--independent-scoring] [--save-to-hf-hub]
               [--hf-hub-dataset-name HF_HUB_DATASET_NAME]
               [--extra-env-kwargs EXTRA_ENV_KWARGS] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
               [--fullscreen] [--disable-tui] [--max-retries MAX_RETRIES]
               [--disable-env-server] [--num-workers NUM_WORKERS]
               [--abbreviated-summary] [--heartbeat-url HEARTBEAT_URL]
               environment

positional arguments:
  environment      Environment module name or path to TOML config file.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --env-args ENV_ARGS, -a ENV_ARGS
                        Environment module arguments as JSON object (e.g.,
                        '{"key": "value", "num": 42}')
  --env-dir-path ENV_DIR_PATH
                        Path to environments directory
  --provider {prime,openrouter,openai,anthropic,minimax,deepseek,glm,local,vllm}, -p {prime,openrouter,openai,anthropic,minimax,deepseek,glm,local,vllm}
                        Inference provider shorthand. Resolves --api-base-url
                        and --api-key-var automatically. Explicit --api-base-
                        url / --api-key-var take precedence. Overrides
                        endpoint registry when model is in registry. Falls
                        back to 'prime' when model is not in registry.
  --endpoints-path ENDPOINTS_PATH, -e ENDPOINTS_PATH
                        Path to API endpoints TOML registry
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
                        Name of model to evaluate
  --api-client-type {openai_completions,openai_chat_completions,openai_chat_completions_token,openai_responses,renderer,anthropic_messages,nemorl_chat_completions}
                        Which client type to use ('openai_completions',
                        'openai_chat_completions',
                        'openai_chat_completions_token', 'openai_responses',
                        'renderer', 'anthropic_messages',
                        'nemorl_chat_completions')
  --api-key-var API_KEY_VAR, -k API_KEY_VAR
                        Environment variable name for API key (overrides
                        --provider)
  --api-base-url API_BASE_URL, -b API_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for API (overrides --provider)
  --header HEADER       Extra HTTP header to pass to inference API. 'Name:
                        Value'. Repeatable.
  --header-from-state HEADER_FROM_STATE
                        Per-request HTTP header whose value is read from the
                        rollout state. 'Name: state_key' (e.g. 'X-Session-ID:
                        trajectory_id'). Repeatable. Defaults to X-Session-
                        ID=trajectory_id if unset.
  --num-examples NUM_EXAMPLES, -n NUM_EXAMPLES
                        Number of examples to evaluate
  --rollouts-per-example ROLLOUTS_PER_EXAMPLE, -r ROLLOUTS_PER_EXAMPLE
                        Number of rollouts per example
  --shuffle             Shuffle the evaluation dataset before selecting
                        examples
  --shuffle-seed SHUFFLE_SEED
                        Seed for --shuffle. Defaults to 0 when --shuffle is
                        enabled.
  --max-concurrent MAX_CONCURRENT, -c MAX_CONCURRENT
                        Maximum number of concurrent requests
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS, -t MAX_TOKENS
                        Maximum number of tokens to generate (unset to use
                        model default)
  --temperature TEMPERATURE, -T TEMPERATURE
                        Temperature for sampling
  --sampling-args SAMPLING_ARGS, -S SAMPLING_ARGS
                        Sampling arguments as JSON object. Keys here override
                        --max-tokens/--temperature. Example:
                        '{"enable_thinking": false, "max_tokens": 256}'
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR, -o OUTPUT_DIR
                        Custom output directory for evaluation results and
                        logs
  --verbose, -v         Verbose output
  --no-interleave-scoring, -N
                        Disable interleaving of scoring
  --state-columns STATE_COLUMNS, -C STATE_COLUMNS
                        Comma-separated list of state columns to save (e.g.,
                        'turn,timing')
  --save-results, -s    Save results to disk
  --resume [PATH], -R [PATH]
                        Resume from a previous run. Optionally provide a PATH;
                        if omitted, auto-detect the latest incomplete matching
                        run.
  --independent-scoring, -i
                        Score each rollout individually instead of scoring by
                        group
  --save-to-hf-hub, -H  Save dataset to Hugging Face Hub
  --hf-hub-dataset-name HF_HUB_DATASET_NAME, -D HF_HUB_DATASET_NAME
                        Name of dataset to save to Hugging Face Hub
  --extra-env-kwargs EXTRA_ENV_KWARGS, -x EXTRA_ENV_KWARGS
                        Extra environment as JSON object (e.g., '{"key":
                        "value", "num": 42}'). Passed to environment
                        constructor.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Per-rollout wall-clock timeout in seconds. Overrides
                        timeout_seconds in --extra-env-kwargs.
  --fullscreen, -f      Use fullscreen (alternate-screen) mode for the Rich
                        live evaluation display
  --disable-tui, -d     Disable Rich display; use normal logging and tqdm
                        progress instead
  --max-retries MAX_RETRIES
                        Max retries for transient infrastructure errors
                        (default: 3)
  --disable-env-server  Do not start env servers when evaluating environments
  --num-workers NUM_WORKERS, -w NUM_WORKERS
                        Number of env server worker processes ("auto" =
                        concurrency // 256, or an integer)
  --abbreviated-summary, -A
                        Abbreviated summary: show settings and stats only,
                        skip example prompts/completions
  --heartbeat-url HEARTBEAT_URL
                        Heartbeat URL for uptime monitoring
  --skip-upload               Skip uploading evaluation results to the platform.
  --env-path PATH             Explicit path for upstream environment metadata.
  --hosted                    Run the evaluation on the platform instead of locally.
  stop EVAL_ID                Cancel a running hosted evaluation.
  --poll-interval FLOAT       Polling interval in seconds for hosted evaluations.
  --follow                    Follow hosted evaluation logs until completion.
  --timeout-minutes INTEGER   Timeout in minutes for hosted evaluations.
  --allow-sandbox-access      Allow sandbox read/write access for hosted evaluations.
  --allow-instances-access    Allow instance creation and management for hosted evaluations.
  --allow-tunnel-access       Allow tunnel creation and management for hosted evaluations.
  --custom-secrets JSON       Custom sandbox secrets for hosted evaluations.
  --eval-name TEXT            Custom name for the hosted evaluation.
